page.notes: Right-margin notes are printed in small italic type and abbreviated; they are transcribed as they appear. The last line of the page is broken at the line end ("stimu-"), and the word continues on the next page. Several printed passages in Latin are set in italic, marked with <i>. The marginal reference "Sect. XIII" is a section label. The reference mark numbers ("1", "m", "n") are given in the notes as printed. Some Latin letters in the scan are indistinct and have been read with reasonable confidence; no [?] markers were required beyond these. Some letter forms, such as "s" appearing as long s, are shown as s only in the source image and are rendered as plain s elsewhere per the transcription rules. The running head keeps the printed "Principum, Dissertatio." spelling.
